title: Edgar Mitchell's psi experiments on the way to the moon
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Edgar Mitchell's psi experiments on the way to the moon, about 1971 at The Moon, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and a lot of the astronauts did remote viewing. I mean, Edgar Mitchell is really known for that. Doing experiments when he was up on the moon and

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that many astronauts practised remote viewing, the idea of seeing distant places or things with the mind alone. He says Edgar Mitchell, an astronaut on the Apollo 14 moon mission in 1971, is especially known for doing mind experiments of this kind while up on the moon. If true, it would mean the space programme brushed up against the study of psychic powers.
